players.bio: Álvaro David Montero Perales (born 29 March 1995) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Argentine Primera División club Vélez Sarsfield, on loan from Categoría Primera A club Millonarios and the Colombia national team.
Claudio Andrés Baeza Baeza (born 23 December 1993) is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Liga MX club Toluca and the Chile national team.
Diego Alfonso Valdés Contreras (born 30 January 1994) is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Primera División club Vélez Sarsfield and the Chile national team.
Emanuel Hernán Mammana (born 10 February 1996) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Argentine Primera División club Vélez Sarsfield.
Facundo Sanguinetti (born 1 March 2001 in Lanús, Buenos Aires Province) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Club Atlético Banfield in the Argentine Professional League. [1

Francisco Andrés Pizzini (born 19 September 1993 in Bahía Blanca) is an Argentine football player, who plays as a winger for Vélez Sarsfield. Club career Pizzini debuted with Independiente in a 0 - 3 defeat against All Boys on 12 May 2012. In July 2014 he scored the only 2 goals of the match against Belgrano for the round of 16 of the 2013–14 Copa Argentina.

Imanol Javier Machuca (born 15 January 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Vélez Sarsfield, on loan from Fortaleza. Born in Argentina, he plays for the Malaysia national team.

Jano Jeremía Gordon (born 16 June 2004) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Argentine Primera División club Vélez Sarsfield. Club career Gordon joined the youth academy of Vélez Sarsfield at the age of 7, and worked his way up all of their youth categories. On 12 July 2024, he signed his first professional contract with the club until 31 December 2026.
Lautaro Garzón (born 30th July 2003) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger or goalkeeper for Argentine Primera División club Vélez Sarsfield.
Leonardo Jara (born May 20, 1991) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a right-back for Argentine Primera División club Vélez Sarsfield.
Lisandro Magallán (born 27 September 1993) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Spanish club Elche.
Lucas Gastón Robertone (born 18 March 1997) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Spanish club UD Almería.

Manuel Lanzini (born 15 February 1993) is an Argentine former professional footballer who played as an attacking midfielder. He played for River Plate, Fluminense, Al Jazira and West Ham. He is regarded as having well developed dribbling skills, as well as good acceleration, vision, and an ability to ghost past defenders. He has been nicknamed "La Joya" ("the jewel").
Matías Pellegrini (born 11 March 2000) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Vélez Sarsfield.

Rodrigo Germán Aliendro (born 16 February 1991) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Argentine Primera División side River Plate. Career Aliendro made his debut for Chacarita Juniors in a Copa Argentina tie against San Lorenzo on 15 March 2012.

Ronaldo Iván Martínez Rolón (born 25 April 1996) is a Paraguayan professional football player who plays as a forward for Argentine Primera División club Platense, and the Paraguay national team. Career Martínez is a product of the youth academy of the Paraguayan club Cerro Porteño and began his senior career with them in 2015. He began his senior career on loan with Deportivo Capiatá in 2018.
Santiago Cáseres (born 25 February 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Argentine club Vélez Sarfield.
